description: This Dart source file defines a singleton class 'TodoDb' that manages local storage and retrieval of Todo items using the SQLite database via the sqflite package. It includes methods for initializing the database, creating the 'todos' table, and CRUD operations such as fetchAll, fetchCompleted, insert, update, delete, toggleComplete, and clearAll.

classes.name: TodoDb
classes.description: A singleton class providing an interface to a local SQLite database for storing and managing Todo items.

methods.name: database
methods.description: Lazy getter that initializes and returns the database instance.

methods.name: _initDb
methods.description: Initializes the database, creates the schema if needed.

methods.name: _createDb
methods.description: Executes SQL to create the 'todos' table if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Retrieves all Todo items ordered by creation date descending.

methods.name: fetchCompleted
methods.description: Retrieves all completed Todo items ordered by update date descending.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new Todo item into the database, setting createdAt and updatedAt to current time.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing Todo item, refreshing updatedAt timestamp.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a Todo item by ID.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a Todo and updates the record.

methods.name: clearAll
methods.description: Removes all Todo records from the database.
